Blood Metabolites Measurement and Plasma Proteins — Essay Questions

qs.q: A clinician wants to assess a patient's short-term glucose control over a 3-week window. Which specific blood metabolite measurement should be ordered?
o: D. Total plasma protein assay value
qs.e: Fructosamine is a ketoamine formed by glycosylation of plasma proteins like albumin, whose short half-life of 19 days makes it useful for monitoring glucose control over 3 weeks. HbA1c is instead used for 2-3 month evaluations.
qs.s: Blood Metabolites Measurement and Their Applications: MCQs

qs.q: A patient with suspected diabetes needs an evaluation of glycemic control over the past 3 weeks following a recent medication adjustment. Which blood metabolite measurement is most appropriate for this timeframe?
qs.e: Albumin's short half-life of 19 days makes fructosamine measurement useful for monitoring glucose control over a 3-week period. HbA1c, by contrast, reflects long-term control over 2 to 3 months.
